summary.id: Perwakilan maskapai di Bandara Tardamu (NTT) dan operasional kantor pusat Bandara Nusawiru—memimpin tim ground handling, menangani 4 tipe pesawat, serta mengelola slot penerbangan via Chronos dan AirNav WFP.
summary.en: Served as airline representative at Tardamu Airport (NTT) and head-office ground ops at Nusawiru Airport—leading ground handling teams, marshalling 4 aircraft types, and managing flight slots via Chronos & AirNav WFP.

id: Menjadi perwakilan maskapai di Bandara Tardamu (Sabu Raijua, NTT), memimpin tim ground handling 4 orang untuk menjaga performa ground time sekaligus melatih dan membimbing peserta magang.

Bertanggung jawab atas operasional ground handling kantor pusat maskapai di Bandara Nusawiru (Cijulang, Jawa Barat), memimpin tim 3 orang, berkoordinasi dengan mekanik, membantu pengisian bahan bakar bersama Pertamina/mekanik hangar, dan membimbing karyawan baru.

Menangani & memandu parkir (marshalling) pesawat Cessna Grand Caravan (C208B), Pilatus Porter (PC-6), Cessna 172 Skyhawk (C172S), serta Piaggio Avanti (P180), beserta administrasi dan laporan penerbangan harian.

Ditugaskan menyiapkan armada dan pemeliharaan bersama mekanik pada "Sumatra Humanitarian Mission 2025", menangani bongkar-muat bagasi/kargo, inventarisasi drum Avtur & Avgas, serta pengisian bahan bakar sesuai prosedur keselamatan.

Mengelola slot waktu dan flight plan untuk penerbangan Reguler, Perintis, MEDEVAC, Charter, Training, dan Corporate menggunakan sistem Chronos dan Web Flight Plan (WFP) AirNav untuk menjaga On-Time Performance (OTP).
Membangun kepercayaan dengan UPBU, UPTD, agen perjalanan lokal, otoritas pelabuhan, BUMN, TNI/POLRI, dan pemerintah daerah hingga kontrak penerbangan perintis 2024 tuntas dan berlanjut ke 2025.
en: Served as airline representative at Tardamu Airport (Sabu Raijua, NTT), leading a 4-person ground handling team to optimize ground time and training airport interns.

Managed head-office ground handling operations at Nusawiru Airport (Cijulang, West Java), leading a 3-person team, coordinating hangar mechanics and Pertamina refueling, and mentoring new field staff.
Handled and marshalled Cessna Grand Caravan (C208B), Pilatus Porter (PC-6), Cessna 172 Skyhawk (C172S), and Piaggio Avanti (P180) aircraft with daily flight reporting and external coordination.
Assigned to fleet readiness and maintenance support for the "Sumatra Humanitarian Mission 2025", handling baggage/cargo loading, Avtur & Avgas drum inventory, and crew refueling procedures.
Managed slot times and flight plans for Regular, Pioneer, MEDEVAC, Charter, Training, and Corporate flights via Chronos and AirNav Web Flight Plan (WFP) to sustain high On-Time Performance (OTP).
Built strong institutional coordination with UPBU, UPTD, port authorities, BUMN, TNI/POLRI, and local government—completing the 2024 pioneer contract and securing continuation into 2025.

keyOutcome.id: Menuntaskan kontrak penerbangan perintis 2024 hingga berlanjut di 2025 serta mendukung langsung misi kemanusiaan Sumatra 2025 dengan OTP tinggi.
keyOutcome.en: Completed the 2024 pioneer flight contract into 2025 renewal and directly supported the 2025 Sumatra Humanitarian Mission with high OTP.

summary.id: Menguasai alur transaksi perdagangan internasional, penyusunan dokumen kepabeanan (Invoice, Packing List, B/L, AWB, COO/SKA, PEB, PIB), Incoterms 2020, serta kalkulasi biaya ekspor-impor.
summary.en: Trained and certified in international trade workflows, export-import customs documents (Commercial Invoice, Packing List, B/L, AWB, COO/SKA, PEB, PIB), Incoterms 2020, and freight/duty cost calculation.

id: Mempelajari konsep perdagangan internasional dan peran eksportir, importir, supplier, buyer, hingga freight forwarder dari persiapan transaksi sampai pengiriman ke negara tujuan.
Menguasai jenis dan fungsi dokumen ekspor-impor: Commercial Invoice, Packing List, Bill of Lading (B/L), Air Waybill (AWB), Certificate of Origin (COO/SKA), PEB, dan PIB serta regulasi kepabeanan.
Memahami penerapan Incoterms 2020 (EXW, FOB, CFR, CIF) terkait pembagian tanggung jawab, biaya, dan risiko antara penjual dan pembeli pada pengiriman laut maupun udara.
Menguasai perhitungan dasar biaya ekspor-impor meliputi biaya freight, bea kepabeanan, bea masuk (import duty), pajak impor, dan biaya logistik lainnya.
en: Mastered international trade fundamentals and roles across exporters, importers, suppliers, buyers, and freight forwarders from contract prep to destination delivery.
Prepared and analyzed core trade documents: Commercial Invoice, Packing List, Bill of Lading (B/L), Air Waybill (AWB), Certificate of Origin (COO/SKA), PEB, and PIB under customs regulations.
Applied Incoterms 2020 (EXW, FOB, CFR, CIF) covering cost, risk, and responsibility allocation across sea freight and air freight distribution.
Calculated end-to-end EXIM landed costs including freight charges, customs fees, import duties, import taxes, and logistics expenses.

keyOutcome.id: Tersertifikasi resmi Polindo Program EXIM dan Kompetensi Penyiapan Dokumen Ekspor BNSP.
keyOutcome.en: Awarded Polindo EXIM Training Certificate and BNSP Export Document Preparation Competency.

summary.id: Verifikasi barang masuk berbasis PO, pencatatan stok & stock opname berkala, operasional mesin produksi sesuai SOP, inspeksi Quality Control, serta menjaga target produksi >95% dengan nol kecelakaan kerja.
summary.en: Handled PO-based inbound verification, inventory books & stock opname, SOP machine operation, and finished-goods QC—consistently exceeding 95% production targets with zero safety incidents.

id: Menerima dan memverifikasi jumlah serta jenis barang dari supplier berdasarkan Purchase Order (PO) atau surat jalan serta memeriksa kondisi fisik bebas kerusakan.
Menata barang pada rak/area gudang per kategori, mencatat barang masuk dan keluar secara akurat pada sistem/buku stok, serta melakukan stock opname berkala.
Menyiapkan, mengambil (picking), dan mengemas (packing) barang sesuai dokumen pesanan serta melakukan pengecekan ganda sebelum pemuatan ke armada pengiriman.

Mengoperasikan dan merawat mesin produksi sesuai SOP, menjalankan inspeksi Quality Control produk jadi, melampaui target produksi harian/mingguan 95%, serta menerapkan K3 dengan catatan nol kecelakaan kerja.
en: Received and verified supplier deliveries against Purchase Orders (PO) and delivery notes while inspecting physical condition.
Organized warehouse racking by category, logged inbound/outbound inventory accurately, and ran periodic physical stock opnames to minimize discrepancies.
Picked, packed, double-checked outgoing shipments against order documents, and assisted loading onto delivery vehicles.

Operated and maintained production machinery per SOP, executed finished-product QC inspections, exceeded 95% daily/weekly production targets, and maintained zero accidents under strict K3 safety standards.

keyOutcome.id: Target produksi harian/mingguan 95%+ konsisten terlampaui dengan Zero Accident selama masa kerja.
keyOutcome.en: Consistently exceeded 95% daily/weekly production targets with Zero Accidents throughout tenure.

summary.id: Pelatihan intensif operasional maskapai meliputi sistem tiket, call center, administrasi treasury & Accounts Payable, penyusunan Flight Plan (FPL), serta regulasi ICAO DG, AVSEC, dan ERP.
summary.en: Intensive airline operations training covering ticketing systems, call center SOPs, treasury & Accounts Payable verification, Flight Plan (FPL) preparation, and ICAO Dangerous Goods/AVSEC standards.

id: Mempelajari standar operasional layanan penumpang, call center, serta sistem tiket penerbangan (booking, refund, dan reschedule).
Mempelajari proses administrasi keuangan operasional: revenue, cash & bank, treasury, laporan Avtur, cash ops, dan verifikasi faktur Accounts Payable dari bandara maupun vendor.

Memperoleh pengalaman praktis terkait izin terbang, kontrak kerja sama pemerintah, laporan penerbangan rutin, penyusunan Flight Plan (FPL), slot waktu, dan koordinasi dengan AirNav, UPBU, Angkasa Pura, dan TNI.
Mengikuti pelatihan keselamatan & keamanan penerbangan meliputi Dangerous Goods (DG), AVSEC standar ICAO, identifikasi bahaya, jadwal inspeksi perawatan pesawat, dan Emergency Response Plan (ERP).
en: Trained in aviation passenger service, call center standards, and flight ticketing workflows (booking, refund, and reschedule).
Practiced aviation financial administration including revenue, cash & bank, treasury, Avtur reporting, cash ops, and Accounts Payable invoice verification for airports and vendors.
Gained hands-on experience in flight permits, government contracts, routine flight reports, Flight Plan (FPL) preparation, time slots, and coordination with AirNav, UPBU, Angkasa Pura, and TNI.
Completed aviation safety & security training covering ICAO Dangerous Goods, AVSEC regulations, hazard identification, routine aircraft inspection schedules, and Emergency Response Plans (ERP).

keyOutcome.id: Fondasi langsung sebelum ditugaskan sebagai perwakilan maskapai & pemimpin tim ground handling di NTT dan Pangandaran.
keyOutcome.en: Direct operational foundation leading to immediate deployment as airline representative & ground handling team lead.

Resolved internal technical outlet issues promptly to sustain service reliability and customer trust.

keyOutcome.id: Menjaga keandalan operasional harian outlet sekaligus meningkatkan kepuasan pelanggan.
keyOutcome.en: Sustained daily equipment reliability and high customer satisfaction scores.

Memelihara perangkat jaringan, komputer, laptop, server, telepon kantor, serta melakukan instalasi sistem CCTV dan perangkat jaringan baru.
Terlibat dalam perbaikan dan penataan ulang ruang rapat serta ruang server sambil membangun kolaborasi lintas departemen.

Maintained servers, laptops, office telephones, and network hardware while installing corporate CCTV and networking gear.
Assisted in repairing and reorganizing meeting rooms and the company server room across departments.

keyOutcome.id: Memulihkan aset komputer perusahaan dan memperluas infrastruktur CCTV serta jaringan antar-ruangan.
keyOutcome.en: Restored corporate computing assets and expanded internal CCTV and network infrastructure.
